Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at IISER Bhopal?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Junior Research Fellow position at IISER Bhopal is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Sc. in Physics or an M.Tech/B.Tech in ECE/EE/CS/Physics or related fields with a good academic record and a valid national eligibility test qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000 per month for the Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow recruitment at IISER Bhopal?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application along with required documents to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will primarily involve an online interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Junior Research Fellow at IISER Bhopal.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position is a contractual role at IISER Bhopal.

faq.answer: Information regarding age relaxation is not explicitly detailed here and candidates are advised to check the official notification for specific details.
